parameters.content:
## Image Processing Sub-Flow (PROJ-56)

Runs after plaintext queue is done.
Reads from Redis list `alice:dms:image`,
checks dedup by file_hash in Weaviate Image collection,
inserts new images or appends additionalPaths for duplicates,
publishes alice/dms/done for new inserts (triggers PROJ-55 thumbnailer).

## alice-dms-processor

Nightly batch processor (02:00).

Reads plaintext items from Redis list `alice:dms:plaintext`,
classifies via LLM (Ollama, model from OLLAMA_MODEL_DMS env),
extracts structured data per document type,
stores to Weaviate collections.

### Document Types
- Invoice, BankStatement, Document
- Email, SecuritySettlement, Contract
- BankTransaction (Phase B child of BankStatement, PROJ-29)

### PROJ-29: BankStatement → BankTransaction
After a BankStatement object is inserted, Phase B runs:
1. Cascade-delete BankTransaction children of OLD parent UUID on replace (BUG-13)
2. Delete pre-existing children of NEW parent UUID via GraphQL Get + DELETE-by-ID (BUG-3)
3. Split plaintext into ~8000-char chunks at line breaks
4. Per-chunk Ollama call (1× retry on failure, BUG-4) → JSON array of transactions
5. Dedup by (transactionDate, amount, counterparty)
6. Skip transactions with null transactionDate (BUG-5); drop empty purpose (BUG-6)
7. Batch insert via /v1/batch/objects → BankTransaction collection
8. Increment Redis stats: transactions_indexed, phase_b_chunk_failures, phase_b_chunk_retries
9. On any failure (BUG-8) → IF: Phase B Failure routes to MQTT alice/dms/error

### Redis Keys
- `alice:dms:plaintext` — input queue (List)
- `alice:dms:processed` — processed hashes (Set)
- `alice:dms:queued_files` — in-flight hashes (Set)
- `alice:dms:path_to_hash` — path->hash map (Hash)
- `alice:dms:hash_to_paths:<hash>` — hash->paths (Set)
- `alice:dms:run:start_time` — run timestamp (String)
- `alice:dms:run:stats` — run counters (Hash, incl. transactions_indexed,
  phase_b_chunk_failures, phase_b_chunk_retries)

### Safety
- BATCH_SIZE = 50
- MAX_RUNTIME = 2h
- Dedup check before processing
- Upsert: delete existing Weaviate entry before insert
- Weaviate failure: MQTT error published, item skipped, batch continues
- Phase B failures: warn-logged, parent BankStatement still indexed,
  alice/dms/error MQTT signal published
- Stats: processed/failed/skipped/llm_classified/transactions_indexed/etc.
